title: Privacy Policy
body_html: Mock Pet Foods respects your privacy. We collect only the information needed to fulfill your orders and never share it with third parties without your consent.

title: Refund Policy
body_html: Unopened items can be returned within 30 days. Contact support with your order number before sending products back.

title: Shipping Policy
body_html: Orders ship from our mock warehouse within two business days. Delivery estimates appear during checkout review.
